statement: Every governed harness and checks module obtains its intrinsic-hardened primitives from the chartered shared owner, the divergent parallel implementations are reconciled behind one export surface with test-to-src imports only, and the ambient-intrinsics baseline count strictly decreases with no live-run semantic change.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

src/utils/canonical-json-data.js keeps the owner charter; the harness-side surface (benchmark-semantic-integrity.js) re-exports from src, never the reverse — the repo has zero src-to-test imports and this Quest introduces none.

The two implementations differ by ~547 diff lines; each duplicated concept (appendOwnArrayValue, isDenseDataArray, isSha256Digest, digest/serialize) is reconciled to a single implementation with the union of both behavior sets, and every behavioral difference found is recorded as a finding before it is collapsed.

The shared owner standardizes on the Function.call.bind capture idiom (the 138-occurrence majority); Reflect.apply and bare-alias sites migrate when touched, tracked by the ambient-intrinsics baseline count, which must strictly decrease and never grow.
Migration changes imports and dedupes implementations only; existing guard and live scenario replays produce identical reports, and the test-duplication ratchet returns to or below its baseline.

The first frontier reconciles the two owners and migrates only the top-density hand-rolling files (comparative-efficiency-claim-table, scale-evidence-contract, scale-profile-envelope); the long tail migrates opportunistically under the baseline ratchet, not in this Quest.
